reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: route.ts L8-37 exists and forceLogoutAll() is live (defined in actions.ts:631 and called from the route); not dead code. Gate 2: no trust_assumptions defined in scope; entry point is a public HTTP GET endpoint accessible to any OAuth-session holder — not a trusted internal data source. Gate 3: src/app/api/ is explicitly in scope (BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE lists 'force-logout-all' by name). Confirmed: the GET handler at /api/admin/force-logout-all performs zero is_admin verification — middleware (middleware.ts:34-40) only checks presence of oauth_user_id/oauth_access_token cookies; any authenticated non-admin user can trigger this endpoint during the JST 22:50-23:50 window, calling forceLogoutAll() which uses the Supabase service-role admin client to bulk-insert 'out' records for all currently checked-in users. An attacker can trigger this via GET /api/admin/force-logout-all (during the nightly time window) using a valid regular-user session, causing the entire organization's active attendance records to be force-closed. Severity remains Critical: organization-wide impact, minimal attacker precondition (any Discord OAuth session), directly exploitable.
